message: じょー
KiraFes finally starts tomorrow. I wonder how the town is looking?
I made my way through the residential area, Shiokumi Shopping District, and Asukai Shrine--

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahem! Now then, today's meeting is officially starting!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yo.」
Huh? Nanaka isn't here, but isn't that crowd the Sweets Club?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Can you all eat your snacks without leaving a single crumb?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir.」
W-Why is even Sally mixed in with them?

name: Sacchin
message: 「In place of Nana-chan, who's busy with the Student Council and Yuugiri-an, I'm running the Sweets Club again today!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Preparations for the KiraFes cake shop are all done too, so I've got time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Working hard as the club vice president, I see. Hello, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun! 'Sup!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, 'sup!!」

name: Synn
message: 「'Sup.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yo-sup!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yo-sup.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now that the opening remarks have wrapped up without a hitch, today's agenda is this!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Volume: 'Can sweet curry eaten after spicy curry be called a sweet or not?'」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What a forced agenda.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, don't ya think you can get anything approved just by slapping the word 'sweets' onto it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'Sup!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't try to dodge the question with a weird greeting!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Until Nana-chan comes back, the tasting sessions are entrusted to me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even if you're unhappy with the menu, the only right left to Yumil and the rest of you is the right to remain silent!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's saying stuff like this, is that okay?」

name: Yumil
message: 「Guh, gotta endure it until I become an upperclassman」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't really care either way. Sniff, sniff, smells great. Wanna eat, wanna eat, I wanna eat right now!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Alrighty then, I'll line up the takeout we got from the curry shop Ai no Kuni in the shopping district~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Phantom Curry, Kfir Curry」

name: Yumil
message: 「Apache Curry, Cheyenne Curry, and Cobra Curry」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And that is all!」

name: Sally
message: 「There's one more, you know?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's the F-8 Curry I'm saving as a souvenir for Nana-chan~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa-oa-oa. Oops, my bad. Guess I mustn't eat that one」

name: Synn
message: 「Even excluding Nanaka's, that's five plates. Isn't that too much for three people?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「This curry counts as a snack, so it's totally fine~」

name: Sally
message: 「Time to dig iiin♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Kaha! So spicy, so goood~~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, right! Synn-kun, you take Nana-chan's portion to her~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, leave it to me」

name: Yumil
message: 「Ah, Senpai. Before you head back, could you tell me one thing?」

name: Yumil
message: 「It's been on my mind lately. Between 'curry rice' and 'rice curry,' which name is the right one?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, at my house we call it curry rice」

name: Yumil
message: 「If I remember right, Yuugiri-senpai called it rice curry」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmm? The manager at Subaruya said 'rice curry' is when you pour the curry straight over the rice~」

name: Sally
message: 「And then, when you pile rice on half the plate and spread curry on the empty half, that's 'curry rice'」

name: Yumil
message: 「That theory sounds fishy. There's a saying that claims the exact opposite」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, what could the real truth be--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What are you all talking about? Both of those are snacks--they're candy curries~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Isn't proper curry the kind where the roux comes in a silver dish shaped like a magic lamp?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What's wrong, everyone?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've never eaten anything that fancy」

name: Paqy
message: 「This girl... Looking the way she does, she's surprisingly a rich young lady」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. That's so rude! There's nothing surprising about it, I really am a rich young lady」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eat proper curry too!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~~. Well then, I'll bring some next time」

name: Yumil
message: 「Whoa, it's spicy!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah! Yumil, jumping the gun!」
And so, everyone happily started the curry party.
